# acecloud_images (Data Source)

List available images in the current region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) List of available images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `container_format` (String) Container format (e.g. bare, ami, ari, aki, ovf).
- `disk_format` (String) Disk format (e.g. qcow2, raw, vdi, vhd, vmdk, iso).
- `id` (String) Image UUID.
- `min_disk` (Number) Minimum disk size in GB required to boot this image.
- `min_ram` (Number) Minimum RAM in MB required to boot this image.
- `name` (String) Image name.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Image size in bytes.
- `status` (String) Image status (e.g. active, importing, queued, error).
- `virtual_size` (Number) Virtual size of the image in bytes.
- `visibility` (String) Image visibility (e.g. public, private, shared, community).
